description_en: Cancels the maximum available bandwidth setting for an elastic IP address (EIP) that is added to an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
description_zh: 调用CancelCommonBandwidthPackageIpBandwidth接口取消已经加入共享带宽中的EIP的最大可用带宽值的设置
name: CancelCommonBandwidthPackageIpBandwidth

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 共享带宽所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth
parameters.name: bandwidth_package_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the EIP that is added to the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. This parameter applies only to EIPs. For IPv6 addresses, use IpInstanceId
parameters.help_zh: 已经加入到共享带宽的 EIP 的实例 ID。仅适用于 EIP；IPv6 地址请使用 IpInstanceId
parameters.name: eip_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the public IP address instance for which you want to cancel the maximum available bandwidth setting in the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. This parameter and `EipId` are mutually exclusive. We recommend that you use this parameter for new workloads. If IpType is set to VpcIpv6, specify the IPv6 instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 要取消共享带宽内最大可用带宽设置的公网 IP 实例 ID，与 `EipId` 二选一，建议新业务使用此字段。IpType 为 VpcIpv6 时传 IPv6 实例 ID
parameters.name: ip_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type of the public IP address for which you want to cancel the maximum available bandwidth setting in the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. Valid values:
EIP: the public IP address of an EIP.
VpcIpv6: the IPv6 address of a VPC.

If you do not specify this parameter, EIP is used
parameters.help_zh:
要取消共享带宽内最大可用带宽设置的公网 IP 的资源类型。取值：
EIP：EIP 产品的公网 IP 地址。
VpcIpv6：VPC 的 IPv6 地址。

未指定时按 EIP 处理
parameters.name: ip_type
